name: validation-baseline-v3
note: Error handling and reporting only; no score changes. registry.resolve no longer lets a primary provider that will not import defeat a configured fallback. pipeline no longer reports an engine failure as a skipped response, and records why each dimension is missing. Reason strings promise nothing about recordings surviving, because a deployment without a persistent disk cannot keep that promise. On a full install every provider loads and the primary is used exactly as before, so no scored input changes value. Re-cut because no validation study data had been collected against v2 or the first v3.
